title: Graytness
meta_description: Graytness is a 4-level, 11BR retreat near Grayton Beach with a pool, spa, game room, elevator \& 2 golf carts. Sleeps 32!
description_expanded:
Some trips only work when the whole group can actually be together---no splitting up, no compromise. Graytness was built for exactly that!

Four thoughtfully designed levels give 32 guests room to gather and room to breathe, with an elevator making it easy to move between them. Mornings start slow in the main living spaces, where a kitchen built for a crowd---two refrigerators, two stoves, two dishwashers---opens to a dining table that seats 26 and a pillow-soft sectional in the living area. An adjacent den with its own sectional and Smart TV gives kids or smaller groups a place to peel off, and conversations move easily from one room to the next.

Sleeping arrangements are built for balance. Eight king bedrooms are tucked across the upper two floors for quieter retreats, while two bunk rooms with full-over-full beds bring a playful, social energy that's perfect for kids or friend groups settling in for long, late-night conversations. An eleventh bedroom anchors the bottom floor near the game room.

The game room is its own world downstairs---pool table, Smart TV, and just enough distance from the main living area to let the night take on its own rhythm.

Outside, the pool and spa anchor long afternoons, with the spa offering a warm spot to unwind as the evening settles in. The screened porch sets the scene for al fresco dinners off the built-in outdoor kitchen and grill, with a 6-seat table, bistro set, and overhead fans keeping things easy. Getting around is effortless with a complimentary 6-passenger low-speed vehicle and eleven adult bikes at the group's disposal---plus access to the free Grayton Central shuttle just a short walk away, making the beach a two-block trip.

And Grayton itself is the draw. One of 30A's most beloved stretches, it's known for sugar-white sand, glowing turquoise water, and a barefoot, low-key energy that locals have protected for decades. The village is walkable and full of character---live music at The Red Bar, Gulf views from Chiringo, and a tight collection of surf shops and galleries that give the whole area a genuine coastal-town feel. Hike through Grayton Beach State Park, pull up for fresh oysters at a local eatery, or take a drive to see the Underwater Museum of Art. Seaside and WaterColor are a short drive east when the group wants to shift the scenery.

Graytness was made for togetherness without the crowding---shared meals, parallel mornings, late nights, and everything in between. The kind of place where 32 guests don't feel like too many. They feel like the whole point.

AvantStay provides an upscale experience with services that elevate your stay and save time so you can enjoy every moment. Guests have access to a 24/7 support team and a tech-enabled concierge to book services, such as fridge stocking, mid-stay cleanings, and private chefs. For anything you need (or never knew you needed), we're at your service!

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- This home allows pets for a fee. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Golf cart use requires a signed liability waiver

Parking Details:
- Driveway parking is available for 5 cars max.
- Paid parking is available at Grayton Storage Facility.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
